params.q: is Wolf River Electric being sued

textBlocks.snippet: No, Wolf River Electric is not being sued by the Minnesota Attorney General, nor are they a defendant in that state lawsuit.

The confusion stems from a prominent error made by Google's "AI Overview" feature, which incorrectly claimed that the Isanti, Minnesota-based solar company was facing a deceptive sales practices lawsuit from the Minnesota Attorney General. While the Minnesota AG did file a lawsuit against separate solar-lending companies, Wolf River Electric was never a defendant.

Ironically, the situation is actually the reverse: Wolf River Electric is the one suing. The company filed a major defamation lawsuit against Google, seeking substantial damages over business losses caused by the AI's false summary.

raw.reconstructed_markdown:
No, Wolf River Electric is not being sued by the Minnesota Attorney General, nor are they a defendant in that state lawsuit.

The confusion stems from a prominent error made by Google's "AI Overview" feature, which incorrectly claimed that the Isanti, Minnesota\-based solar company was facing a deceptive sales practices lawsuit from the Minnesota Attorney General. While the Minnesota AG did file a lawsuit against separate solar\-lending companies, Wolf River Electric was never a defendant.

Ironically, the situation is actually the reverse: Wolf River Electric is the one suing. The company filed a major defamation lawsuit against Google, seeking substantial damages over business losses caused by the AI's false summary.
